ns2:section.sectionText: Applied Data Solutions in the Health Sciences- This course will allow students to learn more in-depth about the life cycle of research. From the collection of data through the final research presentation in the course, there will be many opportunities to learn about new software and applications that can be used to bolster their skill sets. The applied nature of the course exposes students to data sets, using and applying data in research, use of excel and pivot tables as well as ways of presenting data findings.
